summary.text: Jen Terrasa is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 13 in Howard County, first elected in 2018 and a member since January 9, 2019. Her official page lists her on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.

paragraphs.text: Terrasa's official page says she was born in New York City and graduated from Oakland Mills High School in Columbia, Maryland.
It lists a B.A. in sociology from the University of Maryland, College Park in 1992 and a J.D. from the University of Baltimore School of Law in 1997, both summa cum laude.

It says she clerked for Judge Howard S. Chasanow of the Court of Appeals and Judge Lenore R. Gelfman of the Howard County Circuit Court, and worked as a Family Law Hotline attorney at the Women's Law Center of Maryland from 2000 to 2006.
The page lists her as a member of the Howard County Council from 2006 to 2018 and as having three children.
It says she served on the House Environment and Transportation Committee from 2019 to 2025.
